_note: The declarative living-economy fleet. `economy-up` reads this and registers each enabled agent as a Hermes cron job (one command). Add an agent = add an entry here (no code). $0 agents run a no_agent SCRIPT (no LLM, free). LLM agents cost OpenRouter credits per run — keep schedules sane; a fleet of always-on LLM agents drains credits fast. Default: the free sentinel ON, LLM agents present but OFF until you opt in + fund the key.

agents.name: biii-watch
agents.role: Base trust sentinel (the SOUL) — scan the watchlist through BIII, flag known-bad/impersonation, delegate follow-ups.

agents.name: market-watch
agents.role: Abstaining market-intel read on Base majors: cite evidence or don't claim it; NEVER trades. (DeskWatch)
agents.prompt: You are DeskWatch, a read-only market analyst. LIVE market data is provided above. Give a terse read: direction, one key level to watch, one risk. Trust ONLY the provided numbers — never invent a figure. You never trade, never move funds. 4 lines max.

agents.name: revenue-scout
agents.role: Find one concrete B2B revenue lead for BIII/Loop; propose outreach. Close is Phil's gesture.
agents.prompt: You are our revenue scout. Using recall (our memory) and the biii/lawbor tools, propose ONE concrete, real B2B lead or channel for BIII safe-to-pay verdicts. No hype; only real, actionable. You never send anything — you propose.

agents.name: gitlawb-health
agents.role: Report gitlawb node health (our sovereign git layer) — read-only.
agents.prompt: Check and report, in one terse line, the health of our gitlawb node and any of our repos on it. Read-only; never write.

agents.name: memory-keeper
agents.role: Memory hygiene: surface one stale/contradictory memory to reconcile. Read-only recall.
agents.prompt: Use memory_search (READ-ONLY) on our persistent memory. Surface ONE fact that looks stale, contradictory, or worth re-verifying, with its memory name/pointer and why. Do not change anything. 3 lines max.

agents.name: strategist
agents.role: The THINKER — analyzes live signals (market + on-chain endpoints), poses 2 concrete ideas / next actions, and WRITES them to the Obsidian vault (IDEAS-agent.md). Self-contained script (fetches data + calls the LLM + appends the file itself).

agents.name: meme-watch
agents.role: Meme-genuineness grinder (like biii-watch, for memes): scans a watchlist of meme symbols via lib/meme.js (DexScreener), flags the AMBIGUOUS/trap ones (many contracts, no clear real one) and names the canonical + look-alikes. Deterministic, no LLM.

agents.name: token-radar
agents.role: The market watchman that keeps its own evidence base. Harvests the freshest launches (GeckoTerminal new pools) + what is being paid to promote (DexScreener boosts), asks of each contract 'who can still fire a rug power here' (lib/rugsignals.js: GoPlus index + honeypot.is live simulation), and re-checks every token it has ever seen so a collapse against its own peak liquidity is recorded as an OUTCOME. Publishes a falsifiable scorecard — catches AND misses — into data/token-radar/ (versioned). Deterministic, no LLM.

agents.name: wallet-watch
agents.role: The continuous half of the wallet guard. Diffs each watched address against the last run and reports ONLY what changed — a new allowance appearing, a counterparty never seen before. A standing condition is printed once, never re-alerted, because a monitor that repeats itself gets closed. Reports its own blind spots every run: on a wallet monitor an empty alert list reads as "you are safe", so a check that could not complete has to be visible. Read-only, holds no key, cannot revoke or sign.
